page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Decorated woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph. Running head at the top with the page number at the top left. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: CUm[?] singularis viri, & propè diuini, Pauli Florenii tempus a-desset, quo ex perversa Jesuitarum societate ad communem hominum societatem remigraret: nosq; illo ipso tempore soli essemus, tum ille, Videtur mihi, inquit, Christiano, rem omnem sincerius & subtilius contemplanti, nostra hæc, in qua versamur, religio Jesuitica tota ex superstitione, hypocrisi & ficta quadam pietaq; sanctitate conflata, ultimaq; hac mundi senectute à diabolo excitata: quæ omnes errores, nugas & superstitiones, quæ, uno ut verbo dicam, minus honesto quidem, & quo sanè inuitus utor, sed huic rei aptissimo, planeq; necessario, quæ inquam omnia turpissima Papæ stercora tum graviter per se olentia, tum uero hoc tempore, quo à curiosis plerisq; & eruditis viris crebrò commouentur, multò magis fœtetia, sanctitatis iam quadam simulatione cŏdita, temperatáue, meandrisq; nescio quibus, inuoluta, orbi Christiano iterum venderet pro aromatis, atq; adeò per vim fermè quandam obtruderet: ut nihil tam turpe, fœcundum & falsum in Romana Ecclesia cernatur, quod hæc nouo non artificio, vel mentis aciem præstringendo, vel omnem turpitudinem & falsitatem callidè tegendo, pulchrum apparere faceret, atq; verum. Quare considerandum nobis etiä atq; etiam censeo: in quanam religione versentur,

page.notes: The woodcut initial is decorative; the letter is read as C (CUm) with [?]. A small mark after "Christiano" (possibly a reference or asterisk) is unclear and was not transcribed. The catchword "senuntur," at the bottom right is partly unclear and is marked [?]. Spelling "Jesuitica" and "deffet" are as printed, with long s and u/v adjusted per the rules. The last word of the paragraph is taken as "versentur," the catchword is read as its continuation.
